- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:around line 247-250 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: CLAUDE.md §26.I says `delete_trigger` on a trigger named by id (including "a checker's own hand-back trigger") must be preceded by a `get_trigger` ownership check. The twin's hand-back step 1 instead says "Deletes its pending safety net (`delete_trigger`, ignore not-found), its own `implement-plan <slug>: safety net` bound to this session" with no explicit `get_trigger` call.
  WHY: In the common path the safety-net's `persistent_session_id` is the current stage session (the hand-back fires in the same session that armed the safety-net, per the arming-the-wait section's `name: implement-plan <slug>: safety net` binding to the arming session), so the trigger does belong to this session and the delete is safe. But if the trigger were ever replaced or the session-id binding drifted, an unguarded `delete_trigger` would touch whatever trigger now occupies that id. The §26.I rule's "Delete only what is yours, and say so first" wording is not met for this site.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
